Additionally, the Planner prematurely declared the task "TASK_COMPLETE" without consulting external resources or engaging other agents (e.g., WebSurfer) to confirm the reasoning or clarify any ambiguity. This error aligns with Example 1 (Case #66), where the agent misapplied scientific knowledge and prematurely concluded the task.
